RSS_enforcement: Immediate original owned-group SIGKILL on observed aggregate above4GiB; sampled observation does not certify an unseen transient peak
RSS_measurement: Pinned ps RSS in KiB multiplied by1024; maximum observed session aggregate retained
RSS_scope: Sum of RSS for all independently enumerated processes whose session ID equals the held direct child PID; shared pages can be counted more than once.
additional_runtime_pin_note: Interpreter hash and Torch version metadata only. Runtime packages, stdlib/bytecode and OS libraries are not exhaustively pinned; no complete runtime closure claimed.
owned_execution_deadline: Independent parent ITIMER_REAL/SIGALRM plus monotonic loop check; starts immediately before the fork and includes child setup/import/operators
